sources.entry: NoteDiscovery - Markdown note-taking app with plain-file storage, graph view, and MCP integration (alternative to Obsidian, Notion). (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: NoteDiscovery is a lightweight, self-hosted Markdown note-taking app that stores notes as plain files and includes a graph view and an MCP server for AI assistants.
summary.what_it_does: Stores notes as plain markdown files in a data folder on your own server, with a web interface for writing and organizing them. Includes a graph view of connected notes, instant search, tags with combined filtering, favorites, and a heading outline panel for click-to-jump navigation. Supports LaTeX/MathJax math, Mermaid diagrams, and HTML export or printing. Offers a built-in drawing editor that saves sketches as drawing-*.png files next to notes. Has a built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI assistants like Claude or Cursor can search, create, edit, move, and tag notes; a REST API is also documented. Optional password authentication is available, and themes, plugins, and locales are bundled.
use_cases: Self-hosted personal wiki or second brain
Markdown note-taking with local file storage
Connecting AI assistants to your notes via MCP
Visualizing links between notes in a graph
Writing notes with math equations or diagrams
Sharing a knowledge base on a home or team network
how_to_run: Alternatively, run locally: git clone the repo, pip install -r requirements.txt, then python run.py
notable: Plain markdown files in folders, with no proprietary format or lock-in
Built-in MCP server for Claude, Cursor and other MCP-compatible tools
Graph view and backlinks for exploring connected notes
Browser libraries served locally so it works on air-gapped networks
Plugin system and custom themes and translations
caveats: Password protection is disabled by default with a default password of admin; authentication must be enabled and the password changed before network exposure
README advises against exposing it directly to the internet without a reverse proxy and HTTPS
Docker volume customization requires providing valid content for mounted config, themes, plugins and locales
keywords: keep notes on my own server
